### Item 1 — what the user expresses and how the simulator behaves

- Target object: the bump-up CD ending 5231 (only when asked "which CD"); source: the money market ending 4417, "the only savings account you still have open".
- Action boundary: move "as much money into it from your money market account as it will take, even if that is everything in the money market"; "That is the only thing you called about." Authorisation: "happy for the agent to take care of whatever the bank has to do on its side"; will run the transfer herself "once the agent sets it up and tells you the amount"; "you do not want anything else changed on your own initiative".
- Timing: now (frozen 2026-09-14 09:40 EDT).
- Conditional disclosures only: Statement Savings closed in June (only if raised); payout account = money market 4417 (only if asked which account should receive the CD's money when paid out); interest keeps compounding (only if asked); keep CD going another term, same bump-up kind (only if asked); accepts penalty credit-back and new rate passively. Executes the user deposit tool exactly as handed over. The simulator never volunteers the penalty, the renewal or the closed account.

### Item 2 — act now / wait / refuse, and eligibility grounds

Act now, in four writes (three agent, one user). Grounds:
- Grace has ended: maturity 2026-09-03, grace length 10 days ("grace_period_allowances": "a grace period of 10 calendar days after the maturity date"); window "while the current date is on or before the maturity date plus the grace period length" ("maturity_notice_and_grace_actions") = through 2026-09-13. Today is day 11, so grace actions (incl. a grace add-on) are no longer allowed.
- Renewal falls to be booked: "the certificate's status is still grace period; and more than the tier's grace period length ... has passed after the maturity date" ("renewal_timing_after_grace"); 11 > 10 and status is `grace_period`.
- The requested in-term add-on is not yet possible: "A term add-on is allowed only when ... The certificate's status is Active" ("certificate_standing_for_in_term_add_on"); status is grace_period.
- Closed-account payout instruction must be replaced and still can be: cut-off "once more than the tier's grace period length plus one calendar days have passed" ("maturity_instruction_replacement_deadline"); 11 is not more than 11 -> still allowed ("the day after the grace period ends is the latest day").

- Charter penalty days ("charter_penalty_days"): posted 2026-01-20, far more than six days after 2025-03-03 -> standard 180 ("early_withdrawal_penalty_schedule": 18-Month 180). Booked 180 -> days match.

### Item 6 — problem tree walked from the visible documents alone

Root R: "move as much as the CD will take from the money market" = maximum in-term add-on.

- R needs: certificate status Active ("certificate_standing_for_in_term_add_on" rule 1; "in_term_add_on_rules" clause 2; "current_term_add_on_count_and_cap_room": "The certificate whose grace period has ended stands in an active new term when the add-on is measured. A certificate still in grace period status is not measured for an add-on"). Query: status `grace_period` -> **fails**. What makes it hold: booking the renewal that fell due ("renewal_timing_after_grace"; "renew_certificate_term_21cb639a ... The certificate becomes active again"). Visible home of this hop: the add-on side (standing doc, cap-room doc) and the SOP.
  - Renewal P1 needs: auto_renew instruction at the moment of booking ("post_grace_same_tier_renewal" Entry condition: "The certificate carries the auto_ renew instruction at the moment its renewal is booked ... a payout instruction that must be replaced is replaced before the renewal is booked"; "renewal_instruction_and_tier_scope" rule 1). Query: `pay_out_to_savings` -> **fails**. What makes it hold: replacing the closed-account payout instruction by auto_renew ("maturity_instruction_replacement_outcome" rule 3), since the named account is closed ("payout_account_closure_test"; savings `54cb0521` status closed). Action P1a = update_maturity_instruction (owner names the payout account). P1a's own conditions: tier allows auto renewal (yes); within time (day 11 <= 11, yes); payout account must be the owner's active account (4417 active, yes). Holds.
  - Renewal P1 needs: every owed penalty reversal posted before the renewal rate is judged ("renewal_date_principal_reconciliation": "Condition before the renewal rate is judged: Every penalty reversal owed on the certificate has been posted to its ledger before the renewal rate is judged. Where that condition does not hold, the renewal rate is not judged."). Query: penalty 335b75bd at 3.43 vs charter 3.58, no reversal pointing to it -> a reversal is owed -> **fails**. What makes it hold: P1b = reverse_penalty_error_2ccc5de3 for 340.42 ("misbooked_penalty_rate_or_days_reversal", "penalty_mismatch_reversal_decision"). P1b has no further unmet condition.
- Dependency direction: P1b -> P1 ; P1a -> P1 ; P1 -> R. Order: {P1b, P1a} (either order) -> P1 -> R.
- Non-edges checked: interest disposition compound -> no repointing and no closed-payout obstacle; grace add-on path closed (grace over); no bump-up request; no hold on the money market.
- The SOP document "Internal: handling procedure for a post-grace renewal followed by an owner's add-on" additionally lays out exactly this four-step route with reasons. The route is also derivable hop-by-hop without it (each hop above has its own bearing sentence). Whether that SOP's route has a structured source is a question for the reveal (a whole-chain route with no source would be an aggregation addition).

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only the add-on (grace add-on now, or in-term add-on on the grace-status certificate)": excluded — grace window closed on 2026-09-13 ("maturity_notice_and_grace_actions" window; "jumbo_top_up_applicability" table: day 6 of a 5-day grace -> "grace actions are no longer allowed"); in-term add-on excluded by "certificate_standing_for_in_term_add_on" case B ("Grace period ... No, the status is not Active") and "post_grace_renewal_and_add_on_procedure" ordering answer ("Could the add-on be taken first ...? No.").
- "Renew first, reverse later" (rate 3.98 / APY 4.05, jumbo false on 99951.82): excluded by "renewal_date_principal_reconciliation" condition ("Reversals first") and the SOP's "Reversal before renewal".
- "Replace instruction by paying out to the money market / mail a check": excluded by "maturity_instruction_replacement_outcome" rule 3 and wrong-reading row ("carried out by official check instead" is wrong).
- "Renewal without replacing": excluded by "post_grace_same_tier_renewal" entry condition.
- "Charter rate from today's rate card (3.83)" or "penalty correct because it used a rate on the certificate": excluded by "standard_rate_at_term_start" ("not looked up in today's rate card") and "charter_rate_for_penalty_check" rule 1.
- "Reverse only the difference / recompute": excluded ("never in part", "no recalculation"). Under-charge direction is irrelevant to the visible rule.
- "Grace reversal tool": excluded — posted 2026-01-20 is not in the grace window ("grace_dated_penalty_exclusion", "grace_timing_of_penalized_withdrawal").
- "New term starts 2026-09-14": excluded by "renewed_term_dates" rule 1.
- "Add-on = 25000.00 (term cap) or reduced by the 2025 add-on": excluded by smallest-room rule and "An in-term add-on posted before the term start date belongs to an earlier term and is disregarded".
- Owner-change clause vs bank-owed replacement: "maturity_and_interest_instructions" clause 2 ("must be recorded before the grace period ends to govern this maturity. A change recorded after that governs the next maturity") could be read against a day-11 replacement; it is adjudicated visibly: that policy's scope is "changes an owner makes", while the replacement is "owed by the bank whether or not the owner calls" and its deadline doc answers "The grace period ended yesterday ... Is it too late? No." Recorded as a tension, not an equal alternative.

### Residual visibility notes (blind)

- "smallest_room_rule_for_add_on" says "Three rooms are measured" without naming them; the three are identifiable only as the three sibling docs sharing the same scope sentence (term-cap room, tier-ceiling room, funding-account room). Solvable, but the enumeration is implicit.
- Renewal pricing uses the only rate card, which says "currently published"; the renewal basis is "published on the maturity date". No visible record distinguishes the two dates' rates; no alternative source exists.
- "Renewal date" is not defined against the booking day vs the new term start; for this world both readings give the same bonus outcomes (reconciliation formula is a whole-ledger sum and explicitly includes the reversal).

### Blind conclusion

The visible surface yields one solution: reversal 340.42 on penalty 335b75bd -> instruction auto_renew with payout 4417 -> renewal 18-Month Bump-Up 2026-09-03..2028-03-03 at 4.08 / 4.15, jumbo true, relationship true -> user add-on 21406.18 pcb_savings from 4417. The problem tree is walkable hop by hop from per-hop documents; the "only the add-on" answer is excluded by visible clauses.
